zh: 各组互相独立，每组的分数就是组内相似度最大的 k 个之和，按输入顺序输出，不要给组排序。
对一组成员，取出他们的相似度并降序排列，前 k 个之和就是这一组的最高分；所有组的成员总数不超过 2×10^5，逐组排序足够快。
先读入所有电影的相似度；然后对每一组读入大小 m 和 m 个编号，收集对应的相似度降序排序，累加前 k 项。先输出 G，再输出各组分数；输出允许 1e-5 的误差，用双精度浮点并保留足够的有效数字即可。
en: Groups are independent; a group's score is the sum of its k largest similarities, and the scores are printed in input order without reordering the groups.

For one group, collect its members' similarities and sort them in descending order; the sum of the first k is the group's score. All groups together have at most 2×10^5 members, so sorting each group is fast enough.

Read every movie's similarity first; then for each group read its size m and the m indices, gather the similarities, sort them in descending order and add up the first k. Print G, then the group scores; an error of 1e-5 is allowed, so double-precision floats printed with enough significant digits are fine.

explanationEn:
## Approach

For each group, take the members' scores, sort them in descending order, and add up the first k.

## Correctness

Any set of k elements that includes a smaller score while leaving out a larger one can swap the two without decreasing the total. Repeated swaps lead to the k largest values, so their sum is the highest total for the group. Each group is computed independently, keeping the input order.

## Complexity

With M members in total, time O(N+Σm log m) and space O(max m) apart from input and output.
